parameters.content:
## Hacker News keyword monitor → email

Watch Hacker News for the keywords you care about, let AI keep only what is relevant and worth your time, and get a digest of the highest-signal posts and launches.

### How it works
Set your keywords and a points floor. A Code node builds a Hacker News search for each keyword (recent stories above your traction threshold), a native HTTP Request node fetches the results from the HN Algolia API, and a Code node parses and tags each story by keyword, de-duplicates, and sorts by points. A single AI call drops off-topic matches, picks what this reader would actually want (a launch, a tool, a hiring signal, a thread to join), and explains why each matters. The picks are emailed with points, comment links and the matching keyword.

### Setup
- Edit the config node: keywords, tracking context, minimum points, look-back window and send-to address.
- Add credentials in the canvas: Anthropic on the analysis HTTP node and Gmail on the send node.
- The HN Algolia API is public and needs no key; the Schedule Trigger runs on an interval.

### Customization
Lower the points floor to catch launches early, add product or competitor names, run it hourly for a real-time radar, or swap the email for Slack.

Built by **nocode.expert** — done-for-you automation and AI workflows. https://nocode.expert

## 1. Search & tag
Build an HN Algolia search per keyword (recent, above your points floor), fetch with the HTTP node, then parse and tag each story by keyword.

## 2. Filter with AI
One AI call drops off-topic matches, picks what you would actually want, and says why each matters.

## 3. Email digest
Picks emailed with points, comment links and the matching keyword. Swap for Slack if you prefer.
